result:
Comments, deletion, reporting and auto-hiding are in, and `pnpm typecheck` passes. I didn't run the app or any of the endpoints, so none of the behaviour has been exercised.

- **Storage:** `db/schema.ts` gains `comments` and `comment_reports`. The pair (`comment_id`, `user_id`) is unique, and both tables cascade on delete. I generated the migration with `void db generate`.
- **Commenting:** `POST /posts/:id?comment` is a new action in `pages/posts/[id].server.ts`. The body is 1–2000 characters, validated in `lib/validators.ts` in the same way as a post title. A signed-in user gets a redirect back to the post. A guest with a valid body is sent to `/login`. A guest with an invalid body gets the validation error instead of the redirect, because validation runs before the sign-in check.
- **Post page data:** the loader now returns `comments`, oldest first, with any comment that has three or more distinct reporters left out. It also returns `viewerId`, which I added for the UI.
- **Deleting a post:** the delete action now removes the post's reports and comments explicitly as well as relying on the cascade.
- **Delete and report:** `DELETE /comments/:id` and `POST /comments/:id/report` are in `routes/comments/`.
  - **Delete:** the comment's author or the post's author gets a redirect to the post, and anyone else gets 403.
  - **Report:** it always answers 204, and a repeat report by the same user adds no row.
  - **Guests:** both redirect to `/login`.
  - **Missing comments:** an unknown comment id returns 404.
- **UI:** `pages/posts/[id].tsx` shows the comments with author and date, a comment box when signed in, and Delete and Report buttons. Delete shows only to the comment's author or the post's author. The two buttons call the new endpoints with `fetch`, because the typed `action` helper only covers page actions.

The shared query and lookup helpers are in a new `lib/comments.ts`.
